title: Existence and geometry of Hermitian metrics with constant second scalar curvature
summary: We study Hermitian metrics with constant second scalar curvature on compact manifolds. We first consider a Yamabe-type problem for the second Bismut scalar curvature within balanced Hermitian conformal classes, and then analyze elliptic equations arising from constant second Chern scalar curvature within a fixed Hermitian conformal class and derive geometric consequences.
